rows.text: [0.25][S01] Welcome back to the show.[1.65][2.13][S01] Today we're looking at how speech recognizers handle more than one voice at a time,[6.01][6.25][S01] and why that is harder than it sounds.[8.12][9.42][S02] Right, because a single speaker is predictable,[11.78][12.01][S02] but a conversation overlaps, interrupts and changes pace without warning.[16.25][17.51][S01] Exactly, so keep an ear on the speaker labels as we go.[20.62][21.05][S01] If the engine cannot tell us apart, that is a diarization failure, not a transcription failure.[26.31]

[0.25][S01]Panel time, three voices tonight, and a question for each of you in turn.[4.74][5.13][S01]Let us start with the newest member of the team.[7.76][8.98][S02]Delighted to be here.[10.05][10.55][S02]The hardest part of multi-speaker audio for me is turn-taking,[14.11][14.35][S02]because the model must decide when one person has finished.[17.64][18.91][S03]大家好，很高兴参加这个节目。我认为最困难的是多人同时说话的时候，模型需要分辨每一个人的声音。[26.52][27.91][S01]And that is the three-voice problem in one clip:[30.28][30.65][S01]two accents of English and one full turn of Mandarin,[34.18][34.51][S01]with a real-speaker rotation between every turn.[37.86]

[0.21][S01] So we said we'd try something different this episode. Let's mix it up a little.[4.68][4.75][S01] Prayer to Asir, Jivai's continuer and Francize C2 prayfers.[9.14][10.41][S02] Bien sûr, pas de problème. Je pense que le passage d'une langue à l'autre au milieu d'une phrase[15.61][15.64][S02] est le vrai test pour un modèle de transcription.[18.14][19.04][S01] Exactly, code switching. Most engines pick one language per utterance and force everything into it,[25.11][25.14][S01] which is how you get fantasy French or nonsense English.[28.64]

[0.25][S01] This pair test keeps two speakers and widens the gap between them.[4.26][4.68][S01] One voice is a British man, the other an American woman.[8.32][9.58][S02] And that is the whole point.[10.92][11.31][S02] If the labels still collapse with a wide gap, the problem is two voices rather than these particular two.[17.11]
